name: presto-prototype-a11y-mobile
comment: This folder has no dependencies of its own — vue/vite resolve up the tree to the repo's node_modules. A bare `vite` isn't on PATH here, so the scripts invoke the root binary directly (the deploy workflow does the same). `dev` needs the booking prototype running on 6100 (pnpm --dir ../prototype dev) — it's embedded in the phone frame.
